Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [Cyborg] type trait.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "This card/Digimon is also treated as having the [Cyborg] trait" has been changed to "(Rule) Trait: Has [Cyborg] type.")

Effect: This card/Digimon is also treated as having the [Cyborg] trait.
[On Play][When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card in your hand, ＜Draw 2＞.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] By trashing 1 card in your hand, delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon.
